blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pre-trained transformer models are increasingly being used to study scientific and technological progress. Encoders tuned to paper or patent text outperform general-purpose models on downstream classification, regression, and proximity tasks within science and technology. However, the applicability of these models for studying time-dependent or archival properties of science, technology, and their interface is limited due to lookahead and domain biases inherent to these pre-trained models. These limitations arise from training on corpora with unconstrained chronological and text source distributions. We introduce SciTBERT: a family of chronologically consistent BERT-derived language models trained on text from scientific papers, patents, and high-quality educational web text with training data cutoff dates spanning each year between 2013 and 2025. We also post-train these models in a chronologically-consistent manner using paper and patent citations, creating SciTBERT-CI model family. We find that these models generally outperform predecessor domain-specific encoder models even when training data is limited by early year restrictions in the corpus. To further investigate the extent to which this class of models can learn representations that bridge science and technology, we introduce the PatRepEval benchmark, a suite of patent-related text embedding tasks at the science-technology interface. Performance in a variety of classification, regression, and retrieval tasks spanning papers and patents highlights the importance of aligning encoder model representations with the domain distributions of their downstream tasks, and chronologically consistent encoders can match or exceed models trained without temporal constraints.
blocks.zh: 训练有素的变压器模型越来越多地用于研究科技进步. 编码器对纸质或专利文本的调制超过了关于下游分类、回归和科技内邻近任务的通用模型。 然而,这些模型对于研究科学、技术的视时间而定或档案特性及其界面的适用性有限,因为这些预先训练的模型所固有的前瞻和域偏差。 这些限制产生于对公司进行时间和文本来源分配不受限制的培训。 我们介绍SciTBERT:一个由时间顺序一致的BERT派生语言模型组成的家庭,这些模型受过科学论文、专利和高质量的教育网络文本的培训,培训数据截止日期从2013年到2025年每年。 我们还利用纸张和专利引用,以按时间顺序一致的方式培训这些模型,创建了SciTBERT-CI模型家族。 我们发现,即使培训数据受到文书中早年限制的限制,这些模型一般都超过了前一个特定域编码器模型。 为了进一步调查这一类模型能够在多大程度上学习连接科学技术的表示,我们引入了PatRepEval基准,这是一套与专利有关的文本,嵌入了科技界面的任务. 在涵盖论文和专利的各种分类、回归和检索任务中的表现突出表明了使编码器模型表示与其下游任务域分布保持一致的重要性,而且时间顺序一致的编码器可以在没有时间限制的情况下匹配或超过培训过的模型。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The application of natural language processing techniques to study the structure and trajectory of scientific and technological development has undergone a profound shift in the past decades as the computational methods supporting these analyses have rapidly expanded in capability. Large language models are exemplary of this shift: generative models are now used to summarize the literature, propose hypotheses, review manuscripts, and carry out parts of the research process itself ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Many analyses of science and technology, however, benefit from a fixed vector representation of each document rather than generated text. For literature search or retrieval, for example, these embeddings must be computed for tens or hundreds of millions of papers and patents ( Priem et al., 2022 ; Kinney et al., 2023 ; Hook et al., 2018 ) . For these uses, encoder models remain the tractable choice. An encoder maps each document to a single embedding a single forward pass, and those embeddings can be used as features in downstream classification, retrieval, and regression models. Domain-specific encoders derived from BERT ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) have become the standard tools for these tasks. SciBERT and BERT for Patents pre-train on scientific and patent text, respectively ( Beltagy et al., 2019 ; Srebrovic and Yonamine, 2020 ) , and SPECTER, SPECTER2, SciNCL, and PaECTER further post-train these encoders on citation links so that documents related through citations receive similar embeddings ( Cohan et al., 2020 ; Singh et al., 2023 ; Ostendorff et al., 2022 ; Ghosh et al., 2024 ) . These models have achieved state-of-the-art performance across classification, regression, and proximity tasks over papers or patents independently ( Singh et al., 2023 ; Ghosh et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 过去几十年,随着支持这些分析的计算方法的能力迅速扩大,应用自然语言处理技术来研究科学和技术发展的结构和轨迹发生了深刻变化。 大语言模型是这一转变的典范:基因模型现在用于总结文献,提出假设,审查手稿,并进行部分研究过程本身(张等,2025年). 然而,许多对科学和技术的分析都受益于每份文件的固定矢量表述,而不是生成文本。 例如,对于文献搜索或检索,这些嵌入物必须计算出数千万或数以亿计的论文和专利(Priem等,2022;Kinney等,2023;Hook等,2018)。 对于这些用途来说,编码器模型仍然是可取取的选择. 每个文档的编码器映射到一个单一嵌入的单个前传,这些嵌入可以用作下游分类,检索和回归模型的特征. 来自BERT(Devlin等,2019年)的域特有编码器已经成为这些任务的标准工具. SciBERT和BERT分别对科学和专利文本进行专利前培训(Beltagy等人,2019年;Srebrovic和Yonamine,2020年;SPECTER、SPECTER2、SciNCL和PaECTER),在引用链接方面进一步对这些编码器进行后培训,以便通过引用相关文件获得类似的嵌入(Cohan等人,2020年;Singh等人,2023年;Ostendorf等人,2022年;Ghosh等人,2024年)。 这些模型在文件或专利的分类、回归和相近任务方面独立地取得了最新业绩(Singh等人,2023;Ghosh等人,2024)。

blocks.en: Despite their strong empirical performance, these domain-specific transformer models are ill-suited for rigorous historical, predictive, and policy-oriented studies of science and technology. Existing scientific and patent language models are trained on corpora pooled across wide and often weakly documented time periods. As a result, a representation assigned to a document published in year y y may be generated by a model whose parameters, tokenizer, or contrastive training data encode linguistic, scientific, and technological developments that occurred only after y y . This form of temporal leakage is analogous to the lookahead bias familiar in forecasting, finance, and retrospective policy evaluation: information unavailable at the time of the focal observation can enter the feature construction process and inflate downstream performance or distort inferred policies ( Kapoor and Narayanan, 2022 ; Sarkar and Vafa, 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ; Yan et al., 2026 ) . The problem is especially consequential for science of science and innovation research, where text representations of papers within large language models are increasingly being used to perform and evaluate science itself. Although measures, reviews, or discoveries derived from text representations may provide contemporaneous value, the longevity of this value as science and technology progress is indeterminate, and a bias towards prior text distributions could be harmful. Similarly, because they have been trained using knowledge from the present, the validity of these representations as they are employed to understand the past becomes suspect as particular ideas or associations between concepts may have been unintelligible during the period under study.
blocks.zh: 尽管这些域特有变速器模型的经验性能很强,但对于严格的历史学,预测学,以及以政策为取向的科学技术研究来说,它们并不适合. 现有的科学和专利语言模型在广泛的、而且往往记录薄弱的时期中,都接受关于公司集合的培训。 因此,在y y 年公布的文件中指派的表示可能由一个模型生成,该模型的参数、指示器或对比性培训数据编码语言、科学和技术发展,这些发展仅发生在y y 后。 这种时间渗出形式类似于在预测、财务和追溯性政策评价中熟悉的外观偏差:在焦点观测时无法获得的信息可以进入地物构造过程并放大下游的性能或扭曲推断出的政策(Kapor and Narayanan, 2022; Sarkar and Vafa, 2025; He等, 2025; Yan等, 2026)。 这个问题对科学和创新研究特别有影响,因为科学和创新研究越来越多地利用大语言模型中论文的文字表述来进行科学本身的表演和评价。 虽然从文字表述中得出的措施、审查或发现可能同时提供价值,但随着科技进步,这种价值的寿命不确定,偏向于先前的文字分配可能有害。 同样,由于他们利用目前掌握的知识接受了培训,因此在研究所涉期间,由于他们用来了解过去的情况,这些表述的有效性变得令人怀疑,因为概念之间的特定想法或关联可能无法理解。

blocks.en: Chronological inconsistency can enter these models through several channels. First, subword tokenizers trained on the full corpus can encode future lexical regularities even before model pre-training begins, assigning more compact or stable tokenizations to terms that only become common past the date under study. Second, pre-training on chronologically inconsistent scientific and technological text exposes a model to future terminology and later-ingrained semantic associations between tokens that may have only emerged past some date y y . Third, citation- or proximity-based contrastive objectives can use forward citations or topical neighborhoods that were not observable at the time of paper publication or patent filing. These sources of leakage are not only relevant for time-sensitive predictive tasks like citation prediction or renewal classification. They also affect descriptive social scientific measurement, because embeddings trained with future information may mask or distort previously salient but transient conceptual associations. This can cause historical concepts to appear more coherent, proximate, or technologically salient than they would have appeared to researchers, firms, funders, or policymakers at that time. This motivates the need for chronologically consistent representation models for scientific and technological language: models whose training corpora, relational supervision, preprocessing, and tokenization respect the temporal boundary of the downstream analysis.
blocks.zh: 时间序列不一致可以通过多渠道进入这些模型. 首先,经过全面教程培训的子词标注符甚至可以在模式预训开始前就编码出未来的词汇规律,为那些在研究日期之后才变得常见的术语分配更紧凑或稳定的标注符. 第二,关于时间顺序不一致的科学和技术文本的预训使一种模式暴露于未来的术语中,以及后来形成的代词之间的语义联系,这些代词可能只出现在某一日期yy. 第三,引文或相近的对照目标可以使用在纸面发布或专利备案时未观察到的前引文或专题相邻。 这些渗出源不仅与引用预测或再生分类等具有时间敏感性的预测任务相关. 它们还会影响描述性的社会科学计量,因为嵌入未来信息的培训可能掩盖或扭曲以前突出但短暂的概念联系。 这可能会使历史概念显得比在当时研究人员、公司、资助者或决策者看来更加连贯、接近或技术突出。 这就促使科学和技术语言需要按时间顺序一致的表示模式:其培训公司、关系监督、预处理和象征性化的模型尊重下游分析的时间界限。

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we introduce SciTBERT—a family of BERT-derived encoder models trained with annual chronological cutoffs over a joint corpus of scientific papers, patents, and high-quality educational web text—to address this gap. By placing papers and patents in a shared embedding space, SciTBERT supports proximity comparisons across scientific and technological documents without requiring post hoc model alignment. We enforce annual pre-training cutoff dates and chronologically consistent tokenization, enabling point-in-time representations suitable for rolling prediction, event-study designs, historical measurement, policy evaluation, and studies of scientific or technological emergence. We also introduce a family of citation-informed models, SciTBERT-CI, which are post-trained to draw together the representations of documents that are close in a chronologically truncated citation graph. To better measure technological representations and model performance at the science-technology interface, we introduce PatRepEval, a new patent and paper representation benchmarking suite. We find that these chronologically consistent models are competitive with, and often outperform, similarly-sized models containing lookahead biases across both PatRepEval and SciRepEval ( Singh et al., 2023 ) benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些限制,我们引入了SciTBERT——一个由BERT衍生的编码器模型组成的家庭,通过每年的时序断断,在一系列科学论文、专利和高质量的教育网络文本上培训——来弥补这一差距。 通过将论文和专利放在共享嵌入空间,SciTBERT支持科技文件的相近比较,而无需在临时模型后进行相接。 我们实行每年的培训前截止日期和时间顺序一致的标志化,使时间点能够用于滚动预测、事件研究设计、历史测量、政策评价以及对科学或技术的出现进行研究。 我们还引进了一组引文知情的模型SciTBERT-CI,这些模型经过培训后,可以汇集在按时间顺序缩短的引文图中接近的文件的表述。 为了更好地衡量科技界面的技术表现和模型性能,我们引入了PatRepEval,这是一个新的专利和纸张表现基准套件. 我们发现,这些按时间顺序排列的一致模型与类似大小的模型具有竞争力,而且往往优于其中包含PatrepEval和ScirepEval(Singh等人,2023年)基准的外观偏差。

Performance is aggregated by taking the mean over the tasks of each category within each benchmark, then the mean of the two benchmarks. See Table 2 .

blocks.en: Background
blocks.zh: 背景情况

blocks.en: Early text-based approaches in science of science, innovation studies, and science policy primarily represented scientific content through keywords and their patterns of co-occurrences. For example, Callon et al. (1983) suggested the co-occurrence of keywords could provide a constructive basis for mapping the translational behavior of research fields. Researchers used these methods to map the development of biotechnology ( Rip and Courtial, 1984 ) , to trace relationships between basic and technological research in polymer chemistry ( Callon et al., 1991 ) , or to characterize the temporal evolution of scientific specialties ( Braam et al., 1991 ) . A natural extension is to represent keyword counts as vectors via bag-of-words (BoW) or term-frequency inverse-document frequency (TF-IDF) and compare documents using vector similarity. Such representations have been used to map and cluster scientific disciplines ( Glenisson et al., 2005 ; Boyack et al., 2011 ) and to measure technological proximity among patents ( Arts et al., 2018 ; Arts et al., 2023 ; Kelly et al., 2021 ) . Despite their prior utility, these sparse keyword and vectorization methods are brittle, ignore word order, and struggle to capture synonymy and other nuanced semantic relationships.
blocks.zh: 科学科学、创新研究和科学政策的早期文本方法主要通过关键词及其共发模式代表科学内容。 例如Callon等人(1983年)建议,关键词的共同出现可以为绘制研究领域的翻译行为提供建设性的基础。 研究人员利用这些方法绘制生物技术发展图(Rip and Curtial,1984年),追踪聚合物化学基础研究与技术研究之间的关系(Callon等人,1991年),或描述科学特长的时间演变(Braam等人,1991年)。 一个自然扩展是代表关键字计数,作为通过词包(BoW)或术语频率反向文档频率(TF-IDF)的向量,并使用向量相似性来比较文档. 此类表述被用于测绘和集群科学学科(Glenisson等,2005年;Boyack等,2011年)并衡量专利之间的技术相近性(Arts等,2018年;Arts等,2023年;Kelly等,2021年)。 这些稀有的关键词和矢量化方法尽管有其先前的用途,但都是简洁的,忽略了词序,并努力捕捉同义词和其他细微的语义关系.

blocks.en: Topic modeling approaches derived from methods like Latent Dirichlet Allocation addressed this fragility somewhat by modeling documents as distributions over a smaller number of topics. Blei and Lafferty (2007) applied a correlated topic model to study approximately 16,000 16,000 articles published in Science between 1990 and 1999. Gerow et al. (2018) introduced a dynamic topic modeling approach which allowed the authors to study the temporal effects of topical influence and highly-cited and prize-winning outcomes. While principled and statistically tractable, the expensive optimization procedures required to train these models do not scale to the tens- or hundreds- of millions of documents available in modern archival data sources ( Priem et al., 2022 ; Kinney et al., 2023 ; Hook et al., 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 从Latent Drichlet Digition等方法衍生出的专题建模方法在一定程度上解决了这种脆弱性,办法是将文件建模为少数专题分发。 Blei和Lafferty(2007年)应用了相关主题模型,研究了1990至1999年间在"科学"上发表的约16,00016,000篇文章. Gerow等人(2018年)提出了动态专题建模方法,使作者能够研究专题影响和被高调和获奖成果的时间影响。 虽然在原则和统计上可以适用,但培训这些模型所需的昂贵优化程序并没有达到现代档案数据来源提供的上千万或上亿文件的规模(Priem等,2022;Kinney等,2023;Hook等,2018)。

blocks.en: The emergence of Word2Vec ( Mikolov et al., 2013 ) and GloVe ( Pennington et al., 2014 ) introduced the ability to efficiently construct dense word vectors that better capture distributional semantics. By training shallow neural networks that force representations of words or documents appearing in similar contexts to receive similar vectorized representations, this text embedding procedure enables algebraic operations over these semantically dense latent spaces. These algebraic operations saw great success in the materials science literature ( Tshitoyan et al., 2019 ) to recommend novel functional materials in an unsupervised manner. Shibayama et al. (2021) derived a measure of novelty from the average of document word embeddings and Shi and Evans (2023) extended this framework to support multi-modal inputs. Averaging over words in a document or, more commonly, treating documents as inputs to a content prediction as in Doc2Vec ( Le and Mikolov, 2014 ) allowed researchers to encode entire sentences, abstracts, or documents in the same semantically rich embedding space ( Jeon et al., 2022 ; Aceves and Evans, 2024 ) . However, these distributed representations assign a single vector per word, regardless of context, making them ill-suited to polysemous scientific terminology. Moreover, for diachronic analysis they require separate models trained on temporal slices, requiring additional alignment procedures (e.g., Procrustes rotation ( Hamilton et al., 2016 ) ) to compare embedding spaces through time.
blocks.zh: Word2Vec (Mikolov等,2013年)和GloVe (Pennington等,2014年)的出现,引入了高效构建密度单词向量的能力,以更好地捕捉分布语义. 通过培训浅层神经网络,迫使在类似情况下出现的文字或文件的表达方式接受类似的矢量表达方式,该文本嵌入程序使得代数操作能够覆盖这些高度密集的潜在空间。 这些代数操作在材料科学文献(Tshitoyan等,2019年)中获得了巨大成功,以不受监督的方式推荐了新颖的功能材料. Shibayama等人(2021年)从文件单词嵌入的平均值中衍生出一种新奇的度量,而Shi和Evans(2023年)则将这个框架扩展为支持多模式输入. 如Doc2Vec(Le和Mikolov,2014年)所述,在文档中逐字逐句或更常见地将文件作为内容预测的投入,使研究人员能够将整个句子、摘要或文件编码在同一精密丰富的嵌入空间(Jeon等,2022年;Aceves和Evans,2024年)。 然而,这些分布式表述不分上下文,每个字都指定了单一的矢量,使它们不适合多相通的科学术语. 此外,对于分叉分析,它们需要经过时间切片培训的单独模型,需要额外的对接程序(例如:Procrustes自转(Hamilton等,2016年))来比较嵌入空间随时间推移.

blocks.en: Transformer models address some of these issues by embedding sentences or longer documents from the contextualized sequence of their (subword) tokens derived from a multi-layer attention encoder. Beltagy et al. (2019) pre-trained their SciBERT model on 1.14 million scientific publications using the same training objective and architecture as the original BERT ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) . The authors showed that this domain specificity improved the performance of the resulting representations across a number of biomedical, computer science, and general scientific tasks. Srebrovic and Yonamine (2020) introduced BERT for Patents based on the BERT-Large architecture and trained on over 100 million patent abstracts, claims, and descriptions. More recently, researchers have noted that the citation information native to papers and patents can be leveraged to further hone the representations of these transformer-based encoders. The SPECTER/SPECTER2 ( Cohan et al., 2020 ; Singh et al., 2023 ) models fine-tuned SciBERT through a contrastive triplet loss on true versus negative citations for each paper’s title and abstract embedding. SciNCL ( Ostendorff et al., 2022 ) softened the sampling of this contrastive task by first embedding the citation network and using the cosine similarity of these citation representations to draw positive and negative examples, resulting in further performance improvements. Both of these models have achieved state-of-the-art performance across a number of tasks based on paper embeddings. Similar efforts have been undertaken for patents, including the PaECTER model ( Ghosh et al., 2024 ) which performs the same contrastive margin finetuning on the BERT for Patents model as was done for the SPECTER model, using patent citations as input triplets.
blocks.zh: 变形器模型通过从多层关注编码器所衍生的其(子词)符号的上下文序列嵌入句子或更长的文档来解决其中一些问题. Beltagy等人(2019年)在114万种科学出版物上对其SciBERT模型进行了预训,使用与BERT原作相同的培训目标和架构(Devlin等,2019年). 作者们表明,这一领域的特殊性改善了生物医学、计算机科学和一般科学任务中由此产生的表述的性能。 Srebrovic和Yonamine(2020年)在BERT-Large架构的基础上,为专利引入了BERT,并接受了超过一亿份专利摘要、索赔和描述方面的培训。 最近,研究人员指出,可以利用论文和专利本身的引用信息来进一步改善这些以变压器为基础的编码器的表述。 SPECTER/SPECTER2(Cohan等,2020年;Singh等,2023年)模型对SciBERT进行了微调,对每份文件的标题和抽象地嵌入进行了真实和负面引用的对比性三重损失。 ScinCL(Ostendorff等,2022年)通过先嵌入引文网络并使用这些引文表述的同心相似性来取出正反例子来软化了这一对比性任务的采样,从而导致性能得到进一步的改善. 这两个模型在纸质嵌入的基础上,在多项任务中实现了最先进的性能. 在专利方面也进行了类似的努力,包括PaECTER模型(Ghosh等,2024年),该模型对专利的BERT模型进行了与SPECTER模型相同的对比比值微调,将专利引用作为输入三进制。

blocks.en: Chronological text sources for pre-training
blocks.zh: 预训时间表文本来源

blocks.en: The pre-training text data is drawn from three sources covering scientific papers, patents, and high-quality educational web content. All sources, apart from the patent data (which is English only), are filtered to English using the LID.176 fasttext language model ( Joulin et al., 2016b ; Joulin et al., 2016a ) using confidence threshold 0.6 or greater.
blocks.zh: 培训前文本数据取自三个来源,包括科学论文、专利和高质量的教育网页内容。 除专利数据(只有英文)外,所有来源都使用LID.176快文本语言模型(Joulin等,2016b;Joulin等,2016a)过滤为英文,使用置信阈值为0.6或更高.

blocks.en: Scientific paper text
blocks.zh: 科学纸张文本

blocks.en: We use two sources of scientific paper text, both derived from the Semantic Scholar academic database ( Kinney et al., 2023 ) . We source full-paper text from a 2026-03-13 snapshot of S2ORC ( Lo et al., 2020 ) , taking only the paper’s body text. We refer to this data source as S2ORC. To supplement this full-paper text, we also include the abstracts of all papers in the Semantic Scholar database with reported abstracts, derived from the 2026-02-10 snapshot of the Semantic Scholar Academic Graph. We refer to this source as Abstracts. See Table 5 for information on the token distribution of these sources. The production timestamp for both of these data sources corresponds to the year of publication recorded by Semantic Scholar.
blocks.zh: 我们使用科学论文文本的两个来源,两者都出自语义学者学术数据库(Kinney等,2023. 我们从2026-03-13 S2ORC(Lo等, 2020年)的快照中, 我们将此数据源称为S2ORC. 为了补充这份正文,我们还将所有论文摘要列入语义学者数据库,并附有已上报摘要,这些摘要取自"语义学者学术图"2026-02-10快照. 我们将此资料来源称为摘要。 关于这些来源的象征性分布情况,见表5。 这两个数据来源的制作时间戳对应了语义学者所记录的出版年份.

blocks.en: Patent text
blocks.zh: 专利文本

blocks.en: We use the pre-grant long text of U.S. patent applications provided by PatentsView via the United States Patent and Trademark Office. We pre-train on all pre-grant patent claims, detailed description text, summary text, and figure descriptions available in the pre-grant applications as of the 2026-04-10 snapshot. We refer to this data source as USPTO. The production timestamp for the USPTO data corresponds to the patent’s application year. See Table 5 for information on token distribution of the USPTO source.
blocks.zh: 我们使用专利维尤通过美国专利商标局提供的美国专利申请的预赠长文本. 从2026-04-10快照开始,我们对所有授予前专利申请进行预训,详细描述文本,摘要文本,以及授予前申请中可用的图表描述. 我们称这个数据源为USPTO. USPTO数据的生产时间戳与专利申请年份相符。 关于USPTO来源的象征性分布,见表5。

blocks.en: High-quality web text
blocks.zh: 高质量的网页文本

blocks.en: To introduce additional textual diversity, we also pre-train on high-quality educational web text from the FineWeb-Edu corpus ( Penedo et al., 2024 ) , a 1.3 trillion token collection of educational text filtered from FineWeb, a quality-filtered subset of the Common Crawl web archives. We refer to this data source as FineWeb-Edu. The production timestamp for FineWeb-Edu documents corresponds to the Common Crawl snapshot year. These snapshots begin in 2013, so they dictate the first year for which we have reliable record dates across all three corpora. Note that although the FineWeb dataset is deduplicated within each Common Crawl snapshot ( Penedo et al., 2024 ) , the same document may appear multiple times across snapshots. See Table 5 for information on the token distribution of the FineWeb-Edu corpus.
blocks.zh: 为了引入更多的文字多样性,我们还从"FineWeb-Eduacle"(Penedo等,2024年)中预选了高质量的教育网页文本,这是从"FineWeb"中过滤出来的1.3万亿个符号的教育文本,是"共同爬行"网络档案中质量过滤的子集. 我们称这个数据源为"FineWeb-Edu". FineWeb-Edu文档的制作时间戳对应了"常见克勞克快照"年份. 这些快照开始于2013年,所以它们决定了我们有可靠记录日期的第一年,所有三个蝎子。 请注意,虽然FineWeb数据集在每张常见克勞克快照(Penedo等,2024年)中被分解出,但同一文档可能会在快照之间多次出现. 有关FineWeb-Eduacle的象征性发行信息见表5。

blocks.en: Chronologically consistent pre-training
blocks.zh: 时间顺序一致的预训

blocks.en:
We construct a family of point-in-time encoders for scientific and technological text by thresholding pre-training data according to the latest possible time the underlying text could have been produced.
For each year y ∈ { 2013 , 2014 , … , 2025 } y\in\{2013,2014,\dots,2025\} , we train a ModernBERT model on the corpus C ≤ y C_{\leq y} consisting of all documents with production timestamp no later than y y . We refer to each of these chronological models as SciTBERT- y y . For example, SciTBERT-2015 is trained only on paper, patent, and web text with production timestamps in year 2015 or earlier. Thus, the language model SciTBERT- y y represents the model a researcher could have trained at the end of year y y if immediate snapshots of these sources were available.
blocks.zh:
我们为科技文本构建一套时点编码器,办法是根据本可编制的基本文本的最新时间对培训前数据进行分界。
每年, y {2013, 2014, ..., 2025} y\\ {2013, 2014,\ dots, 2025} , 我们用 C\ y C\ leq y} 来训练一个 ModernBERT 模型, 由所有文件组成, 制作时间戳不晚于 y 。 我们把每一个时间顺序模型称为SciTBERT -y -y. 例如,SciTBERT-2015仅在2015年或更早的年份接受有生产时间戳的纸张,专利和网络文本培训. 因此,语言模型SciTBERT-y y代表了如果有这些来源的即刻快照,研究人员在年底可以培训的模型y y.

blocks.en: Each SciTBERT- y y instantiation is based on the ModernBERT-base architecture ( Warner et al., 2025 ) , a 22-layer transformer architecture with 149 million parameters that incorporates local and global alternating attention, rotary position embeddings, and flash attention. Weights are initialized from a zero-mean truncated normal distribution following ModernBERT’s depth-scaled scheme ( Warner et al., 2025 ) . Input sequences are capped at 512 tokens for more direct comparison with previous scientific encoder models.

blocks.en: We train a byte-pair-encoding tokenizer ( Sennrich et al., 2016 ) with a vocabulary size of 50,368 on the combined S2ORC, paper abstract, and patent text only. To respect the no-lookahead constraints, a unique tokenizer is trained for each year y y and is associated to each model SciTBERT- y y . For example, the 2018 tokenizer is trained on the paper and patent text in C 2018 C_{2018} , the subword distribution of all paper and patent text in the corpus with production timestamp in or before 2018. Note that these tokenizer differences between SciTBERT vintages make their encoded representations incomparable across years.

Each SciTBERT- y y is trained independently from scratch: for each cutoff y y we instantiate a fresh ModernBERT-base model and train its tokenizer based on C ≤ y C_{\leq y} . Each model is trained on C ≤ y C_{\leq y} via the traditional BERT masked language modeling task but with a 30% masking rate ( Warner et al., 2025 ) . We use a trapezoidal warmup-stable-decay learning rate schedule ( Hu et al., 2024 ) with 2.1% warm-up, 85.1% stable, and 12.8% cosine decay relative to the token budget for each year (Table 6 ). blocks.en: Contrastive post-training with chronologically consistent citation data
blocks.zh: 与时间顺序一致的引用数据相矛盾的后培训

blocks.en: Citation-informed post-training improves the embeddings of scientific and patent encoders by drawing related documents together in representation space and pushing the embeddings of unrelated documents further apart ( Cohan et al., 2020 ; Ostendorff et al., 2022 ; Ghosh et al., 2024 ) . Prior methods build their contrastive training examples from a pooled citation graph, so documents published in year y y may be paired with documents that cite them after y y . This leakage of future citation information into the representation of earlier documents can amplify lookahead bias in the latent space. To address this issue, we post-train each SciTBERT- y y on a joint citation graph of papers and patents that contains only the citations observable at the end of year y y . We refer to the resulting model as SciTBERT- y y -CI. Our chronologically consistent post-training approach broadly follows the neighborhood contrastive approach of SciNCL ( Ostendorff et al., 2022 ) , which we extend to a chronologically consistent citation graph that spans both papers and patents.
blocks.zh: 引用信息后的培训改进了科学和专利编码器的嵌入,将相关文件绘制在代表空间,并将不相关文件的嵌入进一步分开(Cohan等,2020年;Ostendorff等,2022年;Ghosh等,2024年)。 先前的方法通过集合引用图构建其对比性训练实例,因此在y年所发表的文档可以被与引用于y年后的文件相配. 这种将未来引用信息泄露到早期文件的表述中的做法会扩大潜在空间的外观偏差。 为了解决这一问题,我们在每一科贝尔特 -- -- y 之后,对论文和专利的联合引用图进行了培训,该图仅载有年底可观察到的引文。 我们把由此产生的模型称为SciTBERT -- y -- CI。 我们按时间顺序排列的训练后方法大致遵循了SciNCL(Ostendorff等,2022年)的邻里对比性方法,我们将其延伸至涵盖论文和专利的按时间顺序排列的引用图。

blocks.en: Point-in-time citation graphs
blocks.zh: 时点引用图表

blocks.en: The graph has three types of directed citation edges. Paper-to-paper citations are from the Semantic Scholar Academic Graph snapshot ( Kinney et al., 2023 ) . Patent-to-patent citations come from the USPTO citation records of granted, non-withdrawn U.S. utility patents. Patent-to-paper citations are derived from the Reliance on Science patent-to-paper citation dataset ( Marx and Fuegi, 2020 ) whose OpenAlex works we link to Semantic Scholar papers through DOI. Papers are dated by their Semantic Scholar publication year. Patents are dated by their grant year. An edge enters the year- y y graph only if both of its endpoints are dated no later than y y . This removes forward-citation lookahead biases: no document in the year- y y graph is linked to a document that did not yet exist. We keep only documents that can be embedded, namely papers with both a title and an abstract. Patents are filtered to utility patents. The resulting 2025 2025 graph contains 28.1 28.1 million papers, 8.1 8.1 million patents, and 642 642 million citation edges. Table 3 reports the graph at every yearly cutoff.

blocks.en: Neighborhood sampling
blocks.zh: 邻居抽样

blocks.en: As shown by Ostendorff et al. (2022) , contrastive learning over citation graphs benefits from continuity in the negative sampling procedure. One way to understand this is by noticing that drawing negative samples from the set of papers that are not cited by another does not guarantee that they are not conceptually similar. Rather than treating cited documents as positives directly, we sample positives and negatives from each document’s neighborhood based on a continuous embedding of the graph ( Ostendorff et al., 2022 ) . We train node2vec ( Grover and Leskovec, 2016 ) embeddings on the year- y y undirected citation graph and retrieve the 4,000 4{,}000 nearest neighbors of each training anchor by cosine similarity. Following Ostendorff et al. (2022) , the five neighbors ranked 21 21 st to 25 25 th are the anchor’s positives, and the neighbors ranked 3,999 3{,}999 th and 4,000 4{,}000 th are its hard negatives. We draw 180,000 180{,}000 paper anchors, 120,000 120{,}000 patent anchors, and a further 50,000 50{,}000 patent anchors that cite at least one paper, which leaves about 349,000 349{,}000 anchors after removing duplicates. Each anchor yields five training examples, one per positive. Each contrastive example pairs the anchor and one positive with both hard negatives and one random negative of the anchor’s type drawn from the anchor pool. Papers make up 75 % 75\% of the anchors sampled during training. Due to the relative rarity of patent-to-paper citations, between 1.3 % 1.3\% and 1.7 % 1.7\% of positives differ in type from their anchor, so post-training mainly sharpens proximity within papers and within patents (Table 3 ). However, as we will see in Section 8 , this heterogeneous post-training leads to substantial cross-domain performance gains.

blocks.en: PatRepEval
blocks.zh: 帕特雷普瓦尔

blocks.en:
We introduce PatRepEval, a benchmark of 27 tasks across three formats (classification, regression, and proximity) for evaluating representations of patents and the scientific
papers on which they rely. PatRepEval complements SciRepEval ( Singh et al., 2023 ) with tasks that span patents, papers, and the links between them—including nine tasks that take scientific papers as input and five retrieval tasks whose queries and candidates fall on opposite sides of the paper–patent boundary. Labels are drawn from administrative patent records and established science-of-science datasets, reflecting how patent and paper representations are used to study technological innovation.
Existing benchmarks for scientific document representations, including SciDocs ( Cohan et al., 2020 ) and SciRepEval ( Singh et al., 2023 ) , evaluate representations of papers only. To our knowledge, no comparable benchmark evaluates representations of patents alongside papers, or the ability of embedding representations to relate the two. The tasks in PatRepEval are summarized in Table 1 , and we describe each task format in brief below. Full details of each task are provided in Appendix B .

Each abstract is reconstructed from its inverted index.

blocks.en: Classification
blocks.zh: 分类

blocks.en: Assigning patents to technology, ownership, and outcome categories is a basic operation in studies of innovation. PatRepEval includes twelve classification tasks that mimic these operations. Two tasks classify a patent’s technology area: its primary CPC section (CPC Section) and, as a multi-label task, its subclasses among the 50 most frequent CPC subclasses (CPC Subclass). Four tasks classify a patent’s owner: the type (firm, individual, or government and nonprofit) of its first assignee (Assignee Type), and whether the assignee is an academic or public institution (Academic Public), a U.S. organization (US Foreign), or a venture-backed firm (VC Backed) ( Ewens and Marx, 2024 ) . Two tasks classify outcomes: whether a pre-grant application is granted or abandoned (Grant Abandon), and whether a granted patent is maintained through its eighth year according to USPTO maintenance fee records (Renewal). The remaining four tasks capture links between patents and science. We refer to a patent and a paper that disclose the same invention as a patent–paper pair (PPP) ( Marx and Fuegi, 2020 ) , and to a scientist who is also named as an inventor on U.S. patents as a Pasteur’s quadrant researcher (PQR) ( Scharfmann et al., 2025 ) . These tasks ask whether a patent, or a paper, belongs to a PPP with a match score of at least 3 (PPP Patent, PPP Paper), and whether it was written by a PQR identified with a confidence of at least 0.7 (PQR Patent, PQR Paper). We evaluate embeddings on these classification tasks by training a linear probe on the frozen training embeddings and scoring its test predictions with binary F1 for two-class tasks and macro F1 otherwise.
blocks.zh: 将专利授予技术、所有权和成果类别是创新研究中的一项基本业务。 PatRep 读取 Eval包括十二个模仿这些操作的分类任务. 两项任务将专利技术领域归为一类:其主要CPC科(CPC科),并作为多标签任务,在CPC最常见的50个子类中分为子类. 四项任务将专利所有人分类:第一受让人的类型(公司、个人或政府和非政府),以及受让人是学术机构还是公共机构(学术公众)、美国组织(美国外国)还是风险支持公司(VC Backed)(Ewens and Marx, 2024)。 两项任务对结果进行分类:授予前申请是获准还是放弃(Grant Bound),以及根据USPTO的维护费记录(续),授予的专利是否维持了第八年. 其余四项任务捕捉专利和科学之间的联系。 我们提到一项专利和一份文件,其中披露了与专利相同的发明 — — 纸对(PPP)(Marx and Fuegi, 2020年),并提到一名科学家,他也被命名为美国专利上的发明人,是巴斯德的四方研究者(PQR)(Scharfmann等,2025年)。 这些任务询问一项专利,或一份文件是否属于至少3分相匹配的PPP(PPP专利,PPP文件),以及它是否由信心至少为0.7的PQR确定(PQR专利,PQR文件)所撰写. 我们通过对被冻结的训练嵌入的线性探测器进行培训来评价嵌入这些分类任务,并用二进制F1来评分其测试预测,用于两等任务,而宏观F1则不然.

blocks.en: Regression
blocks.zh: 回归

blocks.en:
The four regression tasks predict quantities associated with the timing, value, and influence of a document: a patent’s grant year (Grant Year), the number of distinct patents citing it within five years of grant (Forward Citation), its estimated market value (Kogan Value) ( Kogan et al., 2017 ) , and,
for a paper, the number of distinct U.S. utility patents that cite it (Science Uptake) ( Marx and Fuegi, 2020 ) . Count and value targets are log-transformed. We evaluate embeddings on regression by fitting a ridge regression, with its regularization chosen on held-out training data, and report Kendall’s τ \tau between the predicted and true values.
blocks.zh:
四项回归任务预测了与文件的时间、价值和影响相关的数量:专利授予年(Grant Year),在授予五年内援引的专利数量(Grant Grant Year),其估计市场价值(Kogan Value)(Kogan等,2017年),以及,
本文引用的美国专利数量(Science Uptake)(Marx和Fuegi,2020年) 计数和值目标为日志转换. 并报告肯德尔在预测值和真实值之间的推想。

blocks.en: Proximity
blocks.zh: 亲近性

blocks.en: Proximity tasks rank candidate documents by their relatedness to a query document. This task family mimics operations underlying prior-art search, technology mapping, and relatedness measures between patents and papers. Five tasks relate patents to patents: retrieving the patents that share an inventor with the query (Same Inventor), the patents it cites (Patent Cite), the patents co-cited with it by at least two later patents (Patent Cocite), the patents sharing its initial assignee (Same Initial Assignee), and the patents held by an assignee given the mean embedding of a sample of that assignee’s other patents (Assignee Patent Match). The remaining six tasks involve papers. Using the patent-to-paper citations of Marx and Fuegi (2020) , we retrieve the papers cited by a patent (Patent Paper Citation), the patents citing a paper (Paper Patent Retrieval), and the papers co-cited with a paper by at least two patents (Papers Cocite). Using the PPP and PQR links, we retrieve the patent paired with a paper (PPP Paper Patent), and the papers or patents produced by the PQR behind a query patent or paper (PQR Patent Paper, PQR Paper Patent). We evaluate embeddings on proximity by ranking every document in a fixed corpus of 100,000 or 500,000 documents by cosine similarity to the query, and report mean average precision (MAP) and nDCG@10 against binary relevance labels.
blocks.zh: 近似任务根据候选人文件与查询文件的关联程度排序. 这一任务家族模仿了先行艺术搜索、技术绘图和专利与论文之间相关计量的操作。 五项任务涉及专利:检索与查询共享发明人的专利(同一发明人)、它所引用的专利(Patent Cite)、至少后来的两个专利(Patent Cocite)、共享其初始受让人的专利(同一初始受让人),以及受让人持有的专利,因为该受让人的其他专利样本(Assignee Patent Match)是平均嵌入的。 其余六项任务涉及文件。 我们利用马克思和Fuegi(2020年)的专利对纸引用,检索了专利(Patent Paper Citation)所引用的论文,引用了论文(Paper Patent Retrieval)的专利,以及至少两个专利(Papers Cocite)与论文共同引用的论文. 使用PPP和PQR链接,我们检索了与一纸(PPP纸专利)配对的专利,以及PQR在查询专利或一纸(PQR专利,PQR纸专利)后所生产的论文或专利. 我们通过对10万或50万文件的固定内容进行同查询相近的同位素排序来评价嵌入相近性,并根据二进制相关标签报告平均精确度(MAP)和nDCG@10。

blocks.en: For the classification and regression tasks we assign 20% of the examples from each year to the test set, so that the test set preserves the temporal distribution of the full task, and most proximity tasks draw their queries as a year-stratified 1% sample. We report all PatRepEval scores on a 0–100 scale to match the scaling of SciRepEval. PatRepEval is publicly available (Appendix B.6 ). Appendix B also provides further information on the underlying data sources and their licenses.
blocks.zh: 对于分类和回归任务,我们把每年20%的示例分配到测试集,这样测试集就可以保留全部任务的时间分布,大多数相近任务会将它们的查询作为一年级的1%样本. 我们以0-100的比例报告所有帕特雷普埃瓦尔的分数,以匹配斯克雷普埃瓦尔的分数. PatRepEval公开发行(附录B.6. 附 录 B还提供关于基本数据来源及其许可证的进一步资料。

blocks.en: Evaluation setup
blocks.zh: 评价设置

blocks.en: We evaluate each SciTBERT- y y and SciTBERT- y y -CI model on PatRepEval and SciRepEval. We benchmark these models against a collection of BERT-derived models of similar size. We do not perform any task-specific adaptation or fine-tuning prior to evaluation: the reported performance is derived from each model’s mean-pooled embeddings of the task input.
blocks.zh: 我们在PatrepEval和ScirepEval上评估每个SciTBERT -y和SciTBERT -y -CI模型. 我们将这些模型与BERT衍生的大小相仿的模型对照。 在评价之前,我们不执行任何针对具体任务的调整或微调:报告的业绩来自每个模型对任务投入的平分嵌入。

blocks.en: SciRepEval
blocks.zh: 剪辑

blocks.en: SciRepEval ( Singh et al., 2023 ) is a scientific document embedding benchmark composed of 24 tasks spanning regression, classification, ranking, and search. Models are evaluated by embedding the concatenation of paper title and abstract text for both the train and test split of each task by mean pooling the input representation. Each task evaluation trains a simple model using the training abstract and title embeddings. This task-specific model is then used to predict the test set. We report performance on 18 of SciRepEval’s 24 tasks. Citation Prediction is a training-only task, and S2AND requires a separate evaluation pipeline. MeSH Descriptors, SciDocs-MAG, SciDocs-MeSH Diseases, and Paper-Reviewer Matching were omitted for brevity.
blocks.zh: SciRepEval(Singh等人,2023年)是一个科学文件嵌入基准,由24个任务组成,涉及回归、分类、排名和搜索。 模型通过嵌入对列车的纸质标题和抽象文本的调和来评价,并通过平均集合输入代表来对每个任务的分拆进行测试. 每个任务评价都使用培训抽象和标题嵌入来训练一个简单的模型. 这个任务特定的模型随后被用来预测测试集. 我们报告SciRepEval24个任务中的18个任务的执行情况。 引用预测只是训练任务,S2AND需要单独的评价管道. MeSH 描述器, SciDocs-MAG , SciDocs- MeSH 疾病和纸张审查者比对因简短而略去。

blocks.en: Baseline models
blocks.zh: 基线模型

blocks.en: We evaluate the performance of a number of similarly sized baseline models commonly employed to embed paper and patent text. SciBERT ( Beltagy et al., 2019 ) is a 2019 model based on the BERT-base architecture whose paper-based pre-training data was drawn from the Semantic Scholar database ( Kinney et al., 2023 ) . SPECTER2 ( Singh et al., 2023 ) is an extension of SciBERT that was post-trained by contrastive learning over papers within the Semantic Scholar citation network. SPECTER2 is evaluated without any task-specific adapters. SciNCL ( Ostendorff et al., 2022 ) is also a post-trained extension to SciBERT that uses a continuous representation of the citation network to perform the contrastive sampling.
blocks.zh: 我们评价通常用于嵌入纸张和专利文本的一些类似大小的基线模型的绩效。 SciBERT(Beltagy等,2019年)是一款基于BERT-base架构的2019年模型,其纸质培训前数据取自语义学者数据库(Kinney等,2023年). SPECTER2(Singh等,2023年)是SciBERT的延伸,在语义学者引用网络中通过对比学习对论文进行后期训练. SPECTER2的评价没有任何特定任务适配器. ScinCL(Ostendorff等,2022年)也是经过训练后延伸至SciBERT,使用引文网络的连续表示来进行对比取样.

blocks.en: ChronoBERT ( He et al., 2025 ) is a family of ModernBERT-base ( Warner et al., 2025 ) architectures that were chronologically trained on a quality-filtered collection of web data. Thus, these models are not necessarily domain-specific to papers or patents. Starting from the first model trained on data from prior to 2000, each successive ChronoBERT model is a training continuation from the prior year’s. The ChronoBERT models all use the ModernBERT tokenizer, potentially leaking token distribution information from the future.
blocks.zh: 克罗诺贝特 (He等,2025年)是现代BERT-base(Warner等,2025年)建筑学的一个家族,在时间上接受了关于高质量过滤的网络数据收集的培训. 因此,这些模型不一定是文件或专利的专用域. 从2000年以前培训的第一个数据模型开始,每个连续的ChronoBERT模型都是上一年的继续培训。 ChronoBERT模型都使用"现代BERT"的标注器,有可能从未来泄露出符号发行信息.

blocks.en: PaECTER ( Ghosh et al., 2024 ) is post-trained from the BERT for Patents model ( Srebrovic and Yonamine, 2020 ) , a BERT-large model pre-trained on global patent data. The PaECTER post-training follows a similar contrastive pattern to the SPECTER2 model, using examiner-added patent citation information to tune embeddings. This model has two to three times the number of parameters of all the other models evaluated in this work.
blocks.zh: PaECTER(Ghosh等人,2024年)是BERT专利模型(Srebrovic and Yonamine,2020年)的培养后型号,是BERT大型模型,在全球专利数据上预先培养. PaECTER 后训练采用与SPECTER2模式相类似的对比模式,使用检验员添加的专利引用信息来调谐嵌入. 本模型的参数数是本作所评价的所有其他模型的2至3倍.

blocks.en: Results
blocks.zh: 结果

blocks.en: The SciTBERT and SciTBERT-CI model families are competitive with, and often outperform, models with similar numbers of parameters that are not chronologically consistent. As depicted in Figure 1 and Table 2 , nearly every SciTBERT vintage performs competitively with comparable models across task categories and both benchmarks. The more recent vintages of SciTBERT outperform baselines on regression tasks. SciTBERT outperforms other MLM-only models (SciBERT, ChronoBERT) on mean PatRepEval regression and classification, and trails SciBERT slightly on SciRepEval classification tasks. There are a few vintages that underperform on proximity tasks and one that underperforms in all task categories. However, post-training improves these models’ performance (Section 8.1 ).
blocks.zh: SciTBERT和SciTBERT-CI模式家庭与具有类似数量参数且时间顺序不一致的模型有竞争力,而且往往优于业绩. 如图1和表2所描述的,几乎每个科学、生物、生物、生物和毒素武器研究所的标准都以具有竞争力的方式在任务类别和两个基准中采用可比模式。 SciTBERT的最新版本超过了回归任务的基线。 SciTBERT在PatRepEval回归和分类上优于其他只使用MLM的模型(SciBERT,ChronoBERT),在SciRepEval分类任务上小径SciBERT. 有一些古董在近距离任务上表现不佳,一个则在所有任务类别中表现不佳. 然而,培训后可以改善这些模式的绩效(第8.1节)。

blocks.en: The SciTBERT and SciTBERT-CI models generally perform competitively, or outperform, across both domains. By contrast, the paper- or patent-specialized baseline models underperform in their non-specialized domains. PaECTER achieves an average of 22.1 on SciRepEval regression tasks, the worst of the baselines and 21% degradation in performance versus the best SciTBERT/SciTBERT-CI vintages. SciNCL and SPECTER2 achieve mean performance of about 16.0 on PatRepEval proximity tasks compared to 23.9 for the best-performing SciTBERT-CI vintage. These performance differences also reflect the value of PatRepEval and its ability to distinguish model performance across task categories, especially relative to SciRepEval.
blocks.zh: SciTBERT和SciTBERT-CI模型一般在两个领域都有竞争表现,或者表现优异. 相比之下,纸张或专利专用基线模型在其非专门领域表现不佳。 PaECTER在SciRepEval回归任务上平均实现22.1分,基线最差,性能退化21%与最佳SciTBERT/SciTBERT-CI vintages相对. SciNCL和SPECTER2在PatRepEval近距离任务上实现了约16.0的平均性能,而表现最好的SciTBERT-CI vintage则是23.9. 这些性能差异也反映了PatRepEval的价值及其区分不同任务类别模型性能的能力,尤其是相对于SciRepEval.

blocks.en: Contrastive Benefits
blocks.zh: 对比福利

blocks.en: Every SciTBERT-CI vintage outperforms every baseline on the proximity tasks on average (Table 2 ). In fact, SciTBERT-2013-CI, trained only on text and citations available by 2013, outperforms every baseline on proximity tasks on average. The model achieves SPECTER2-like performance on SciRepEval and outperforms all the baselines in PatRepEval proximity mean performance. All other SciTBERT-CI vintages achieve even higher performance on average in the proximity tasks. Eight of the 13 SciTBERT-CI vintages (2017 and 2019–2025) exceed the highest baseline regression performance. SciTBERT-2013-CI is the only model vintage that underperforms SciNCL in mean classification performance, and all other vintages match or outperform this best baseline. Overall, the SciTBERT-CI family generally matches the SciRepEval performance of the best paper-specialized models (SPECTER2, SciNCL) and matches PaECTER performance on PatRepEval classification. SciTBERT-CI outperforms PaECTER in proximity tasks on average, despite the fact that PaECTER has more than twice the number of parameters.
blocks.zh: 每个SciTBERT-CI的效绩平均超过邻近任务的每个基线(表2)。 事实上,SciTBERT-2013-CI在2013年之前只接受了文本和引文培训,平均而言,就近距离任务而言,其业绩超过了每个基线。 该模型在SciRepEval上实现了SPECTER2-类似性能,并超越了PatRepEval相近中的所有基线即为性能. 所有其他的SciTBERT-CI vintages在相邻任务中平均能达到更高的性能. 13个SciTBERT-CI vintages(2017年和2019–2025年)中的8个超过了基准回归性能最高. SciTBERT-2013-CI是唯一在平均分类性能中表现不佳的SciNCL的模型Vintage,而所有其他Vintages匹配或超过这一最佳基准. 总体而言,SciTBERT-CI家族一般与SciRepEval最佳纸质专用模型(SPECTER2,SciNCL)的性能相匹配,并与PatRepEval分类上的PaECTER性能相匹配. SciTBERT-CI 成绩优异 尽管PaECTER的参数数是PaECTER的两倍以上,但平均近距离任务中的PaECTER.

blocks.en: Comparing SciTBERT to SciTBERT-CI models, we find that post-training mainly benefits proximity and classification tasks. SciRepEval proximity performance rises from a cross-vintage average of about 62 for SciTBERT to 79 for SciTBERT-CI. PatRepEval proximity similarly rises from about 9 to 23. The post-training performance benefits to classification are mostly derived from CPC technology classification. Post-training has very little effect on regression task performance, implying most of the signal for regression tasks come from pre-training.
blocks.zh: 将SciTBERT与SciTBERT-CI模型比较,我们发现后培训主要有利于近距离和分类任务. 剪辑 埃瓦尔的相近性能从SciTBERT的相近平均约62起上升到了SciTBERT-CI的79起. PatRepEval的相近程度也从大约9起上升到23起。 培训后业绩对分类的好处大多取自产品总分类技术分类。 后培训对回归任务执行的影响很小,意味着回归任务的大部分信号来自前培训.

blocks.en: There are a number of SciTBERT vintages (2017, 2020, 2021) that show unusually weak performance across particular task categories. The SciTBERT-2020 vintage is a particularly interesting example, lagging mean performance by close to two standard deviations for most tasks (Figure 4 ). This vintage was such an outlier, in fact, that we opted to re-run its entire pre-training process with a new random seed. However, we found a similar lag in performance even with this change of parametrization. We speculate that this underperformance may have more to do with the interaction of the tokenizer and the data distribution at its cutoff year. Regardless, we observe that post-training is able to ameliorate this performance deficit. The SciTBERT-2020-CI model achieves performance across classification, proximity, and regression tasks that aligns with its expected performance based on nearby vintages. The fact that contrastive post-training can revive performance across task categories implies that the underperformance in the base model may be related to how the latent space is organized 1 1 1 We note that, as is the case with BERT models, the base SciTBERT latent space is anisotropic ( Ethayarajh, 2019 ) . The contrastive post-training over citations reduces this anisotropy. .
blocks.zh: 有一些SciTBERT vintages(2017年,2020年,2021年)显示在特定任务类别中表现异常弱. SciTBERT-2020 vintage是一个特别有趣的例子,由于大多数任务接近两个标准偏差而落后于平均性能(图4 . 事实上,这种古董是超乎寻常的 我们选择用新的随机种子 重新运行整个训练前过程 然而,我们发现,即使在这种准军事化的改变下,业绩也同样滞后。 我们推测,这种性能不佳可能与标定器的相互作用和数据在截止年的分布有关. 无论如何,我们注意到,培训后能够改善这种业绩不足。 SciTBERT-2020-CI模式实现跨分类,相近,回归等任务的业绩,这些任务与基于相邻相接的相符合的预期业绩. 对比性后培训可以恢复跨任务类别的性能,这意味着基础模型中的性能不佳可能与潜在空间的排列方式有关。 我们注意到,与BERT模型一样,基础SciTBERT潜在空间是异同性的(Ethayarajh, 2019年)。 与引用相反的后训练会减少这种同分性。 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: We introduced SciTBERT, a family of thirteen chronologically consistent ModernBERT-derived models for scientific and technological text, one for each annual cutoff from 2013 to 2025. Each SciTBERT- y y model vintage is pre-trained from scratch, with its own tokenizer, on papers, patents, and educational web text produced no later than year y y . Each comes with a post-trained counterpart, SciTBERT- y y -CI, tuned on a joint paper and patent citation graph that contains only the citations observable at the end of y y . To evaluate representations of patents and of the links between patents and science, we also introduced PatRepEval, a benchmark of 27 classification, regression, and proximity tasks, nine of which take papers as input and five of which require explicit retrieval across the paper–patent boundary. Across PatRepEval and SciRepEval, the enforcement of chronological consistency comes at very little performance cost: every SciTBERT-CI vintage exceeds every baseline in mean proximity performance. The SciTBERT-CI family matches the best paper-specialized models on SciRepEval and larger, patent-specialized baseline performance on PatRepEval. While the SciTBERT and SciTBERT-CI models achieve robust cross-domain performance between paper and patent tasks, we find domain-specialized baseline performance to degrade outside the domain the models were trained on. We find citation-informed post-training contributes gains on proximity and technology classification, whereas regression performance is largely driven by pre-training. We release the SciTBERT and SciTBERT-CI models and PatRepEval to support point-in-time measurement in scenarios where the representation of a document should reflect the distribution of knowledge at the time it was produced.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了SciTBERT,一个由13个按时间顺序一致的现代BERT派生的科技文本模型组成的家族,2013年至2025年每年截取一个。 每个SciTBERT - y y 型号的活字版本都是从零开始预先训练的,用它自己的活字化器,在不晚于年份制作的论文,专利和教育网络文本上使用. y. 每个都有一个经过训练的对应器SciTBERT- y-CI, 调用联合论文和专利引用图, 其中仅包含 y 结尾可观察到的引用. 为了评估专利的表述以及专利和科学之间的联系,我们还引入了PatRepEval,这是27项分类、回归和近距离任务的基准,其中9项以论文作为投入,有5项需要明确跨越纸张-专利边界检索。 在整个PatRepEval和SciRepEval中,执行时间顺序一致性的性能成本非常低:每个SciTBERT-CI vintage在平均近距离性能上都超过了每个基线. SciTBERT-CI家族在SciRepEval上和PatRepEval上更大的专利专用基线性能匹配了最好的纸张专用模型. 虽然SciTBERT和SciTBERT-CI模型在纸张和专利任务之间实现了强劲的跨域性能,但我们发现域专门化的基准性能在域外降解,这些模型被训练过. 我们认为,根据引用情况进行后培训有助于在接近和技术分类方面取得成果,而回归性表现主要是由培训前的驱动。 我们发布了SciTBERT和SciTBERT-CI模型以及PatRepEval,以支持在某文件的表述应反映其制作时知识分布的情景中进行时间点测量.

Roughly 14 million of these papers have a title, an abstract, and a publication year and enter the tasks.

blocks.zh: 评价细节

blocks.en:
For classification and regression, we assign 20% of each year’s examples
to the test set and retain the rest for the training set. Years with fewer than 200 examples are kept entirely in the training set. Proximity queries are drawn as a year-stratified 1% sample except where noted above, and queries are excluded from the corpus. For the Paper Patent Retrieval, Papers Cocite, and both PQR retrieval tasks, each query’s negatives are the relevant documents of other queries. Otherwise, the task corpus is filled with randomly sampled patents or papers.

blocks.en:
Embeddings are L2-normalized and standardized with the training set mean and standard deviation of each dimension. For classification, the probe is a single
linear layer trained with AdamW for 50 epochs (learning rate 10 − 2 10^{-2} , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , batch size 4,096) using cross-entropy with balanced class weights for single-label tasks and binary cross-entropy for CPC Subclass, and reported scores are the mean over three probe seeds. The classification tasks also define few-shot settings with k k examples per class. For simplicity, we do not report these results in this work, but the tasks are available and evaluated by default by the benchmark suite. For regression, the probe is a closed-form ridge regression on min–max scaled targets (log-transformed for Forward Citation), whose penalty is chosen from { 10 − 4 , … , 10 } × n \{10^{-4},\dots,10\}\times n by Kendall’s τ \tau on a held-out 10% of the training set (at most 100,000 examples) before refitting on the full training set. Each proximity query is scored against every corpus document by cosine similarity. We compute MAP and nDCG@10 over the 200 highest-ranked documents for each query, using the pytrec_eval library [ Van Gysel and de Rijke, 2018 ] .
